subject: Fix minor memory leaks in dictTest (#12962)
reason: The change touches only dictTest() in src/dict.c, the internal unit-test harness code run via the test runner, not any server runtime path. It frees temporary strings allocated by stringFromLongLong inside the test to silence test-only memory leaks; no command, reply, data structure, replication or persistence behaviour changes, so no fuzzer scenario can reach or exercise it.
